features.name: Dilworth Park Fountain and Pulse
features.description: Dilworth Park Fountain is a 241-jet, zero-depth water feature over the transit concourse, animated by Janet Echelman and OLIN's Pulse artwork with colored mist that follows subway movement below.

details.imageAlt: Dilworth Park Fountain and Pulse at Dilworth Park

features.name: Rothman Orthopaedics Ice Rink
features.description: Rothman Orthopaedics Ice Rink is Dilworth Park's seasonal outdoor skating rink, installed over the fountain plaza during the winter program and operated with timed sessions and separate admission.

details.imageAlt: Rothman Orthopaedics Ice Rink at Dilworth Park

features.name: Albert M. Greenfield Lawn and Wintergarden
features.description: Albert M. Greenfield Lawn is Dilworth Park's 6,900-square-foot seasonal lawn and shaded seating area, transformed into the Wintergarden with plantings, lights and gathering space during the colder season.
features.source_label: Center City District 2026 Dilworth Park fact sheet

details.informationSourceLabel: Center City District 2026 Dilworth Park fact sheet
details.imageAlt: Albert M. Greenfield Lawn and Wintergarden at Dilworth Park

features.name: Dilworth Park Transit Entrances
features.description: Dilworth Park's glass transit headhouses and elevators connect the plaza to SEPTA's 15th Street Market-Frankford/Trolley station complex and the wider City Hall concourse, with accessibility differing by line and entrance.
features.source_label: SEPTA City Hall and 15th Street Station Accessibility Program
